text_block_list.name: Vivlos's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see this magazine!?
Verxina-san and Cheval-san were featured super huge!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ My big sisters are amazing, right?♪
They're super strong racers, and hard workers too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
They're gentle, and they always end up spoiling me~
like giving me treats and rewards♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos's Friend
text_block_list.text: You guys really get along. Do you ever give them anything, Vivlos? Like rewards?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
From me?
From me, huh—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, maybe I've never actually thought about that~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Wait... that might be great!
My big sisters have been working so hard, after all!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna give one of my big sisters a reward myself~♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big sis~! Let's go on a date!
A reward date♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
My, what's this about a reward...
Is there something you want to beg for?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No-o-pe!
Today is a reward from me to *you*, big sis!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You've been working super hard lately, big sis.
So as a reward~ I'm gonna present you with a super-duper happy date♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! This color is so cute♡
Big sis, let's get matching ones!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
But we bought lipstick just last week.
Surely that's buying a bit too much—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~ but it's matching, you know?
Isn't it way better to have lots of them?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I want so many of them♪
Just as much as my "I love you, big sis!" feelings, so, sooooo many♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief, you really know how to play the spoiled sister.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Excuse me, two of this nail polish, please.
Could you gift-wrap one of them?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Mmm~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
So yummy~♡
But... big sis~♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: You want a sip, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
As expected of big sis♪
I love you, love you, love you so much♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Not just one sip, you can drink as much as you like.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, big sis.
I don't wanna go home yet~...♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: That's fine with me, but... aren't you being even more clingy than usual today?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yup♡ Did you have fun pampering me a bunch too, big sis?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Well, yes, I suppose.
It was enjoyable.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Then~... the reward was a huge success♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Reward...? ...Wait, don't tell me—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: The reward for you, big sis... is *M-E*♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Acting all spoiled,
and getting pampered sooooo much by you♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
A win-win, super happy-happy reward♡
How was it?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ............Pfft, fufu, ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ?? Was something funny?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No, I just thought how wonderfully typical of you that was, Vivlos.
Fufu... thank you for the wonderful reward.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's see...
For the continuation of this date—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Shall we go to that cafe you love?
You adore fluffy pancakes, after all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
We'll top it with your favorite ice cream...
Ah, how about ordering a cake to share as well?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Geez~~ big sis...
You're way too good at pampering me♡
